description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade project runtime target to .NET 9 as explicitly requested.
tasks.reason: The modernization request explicitly requires upgrading the application to .NET 9.
tasks.requirements: Retarget the project to .NET 9 and ensure the solution restores, builds, and tests successfully with the new target.

tasks.description: Scan dependencies for known CVEs and remediate vulnerabilities before deployment readiness.
tasks.reason: Security compliance requires dependency vulnerability remediation in every modernization plan.
tasks.requirements: Scan project dependencies for CVEs, upgrade vulnerable packages to patched versions, document any major-version remediation risk, and verify build/test pass after remediation.
tasks.environmentConfiguration: Runtime and build environment produced by the upgrade task.
